[u][b]Version 2.0.0[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Major updates, especially to event triggers.
[*]Starting a new save is recommended. [i](Theoretically, it should work on pre-existing saves, but I haven’t tested it.)[/i]
[*](Maybe) compatible with SVE and Less Ugly Town Interiors. [i](Again, untested.)[/i]

[*]Translations from the older version are no longer supported—translation updates are needed.
[/list]
